variants.title: Wine Crates
variants.premise: He's stacking crates of wine at the end of the pier, ready to shove off.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Can you take me out on the water?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not you, not today. Got wine to move.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: A gull screeches over the crates and he swears at it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Even if I hadn't. I don't cross open water.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: No captain takes a stranger. Their boats, their call.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Says who?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Don't ask me, iknami. I just row the crates.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Captains do. Ask one.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: They'll say no slower than I did.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Aldarin's finest. Don't touch the crates.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Wasn't going to.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Good. Last one who did went home wet.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Suit yourself. It's an island, mind.

variants.title: Rough Company
variants.premise: He's watching the coast road for bandits before he'll cast off.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Got room on your boat for a paying passenger?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Depends what you're paying with, and where you think you're going.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: He glances up the cliff path, then back to you.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Out past Varlamore? Not in this boat.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Charter captains won't risk a stranger.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Take it up with them, not me.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Keep your coin. I don't do open water.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Wine. It's always wine.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: That sounds illegal.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then don't say it out loud.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Wise choice, iknami.

variants.title: Proof Enough
variants.premise: He's untying his boat, ready to shove off without waiting for anyone.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Any chance of a boat now?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: That quiver. Colosseum, isn't it?

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: He looks you over properly for the first time.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Tetamo. You actually did it, then.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not me. You want the harbour in the capital for that.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I just do the coast, iknami.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Show it at the harbour, up in the capital.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Is that really it?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: That's what I hear. Never seen it myself.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Didn't do much. Ask at the capital harbour.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Only rumours. Never paid them much mind.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Now go bother the harbour in the capital.
